stem.en: Which of these landforms was not made by wind?

feedback.en: A barchan is a crescent of sand heaped up by wind.
A yardang is a rock ridge carved by sand that the wind carries.
Yes. Waves cut a sea arch through a headland.
A deflation hollow forms when wind blows loose material away.

explanation.en: Barchans, yardangs and deflation hollows are all the work of wind. A sea arch is cut by waves, which wear through a headland at the coast.

hints.en: Three of these are found in deserts.
